Class NostrTURNEvent

java.lang.Object
org.ngengine.nostr4j.rtc.turn.NostrTURNEvent
Direct Known Subclasses:
NostrTURNAckEvent, NostrTURNChallengeEvent, NostrTURNConnectEvent, NostrTURNDataEvent, NostrTURNDeliveryAckEvent, NostrTURNDisconnectEvent
public abstract class NostrTURNEvent extends Object
Base abstraction for TURN events. The constructor that accept an event arg parses and validates incoming events the other constructor is to create outgoing events.
